title: Lamentations
author: Traditionally associated with Jeremiah.
date: After the fall of Jerusalem in 586 B.C.
audience: Judah, grieving the destruction of Jerusalem and calling the people to hope in God's mercy.
historicalSetting: Lamentations mourns Jerusalem's fall while confessing God's justice and hoping in His mercies.
keyVerse: Lamentations 3:22-23 — "It is because of Yahweh's loving kindnesses that we are not consumed... They are new every morning."
christFocus: Lamentations prepares the heart to see Christ as the Man of Sorrows who enters suffering, bears judgment, and brings mercy to the broken.
